name: Travel Planner by Gildhart
changelog:
• "When do you fly?" is now the planner's own calendar, the same in every browser and on every phone. One large button, "Choose your flight date", opens it; a day is one tap; the months turn with large arrows; days before today cannot be chosen. The chosen day then reads in words ("Friday 12 June 2026"), and the calendar can be cleared or closed. Before, it was the browser's own date field: small on a laptop, different in every browser, and opened only by its small icon, so people clicked several times before a calendar appeared.
  • The price list keeps its own look on every site. A site's own table styles (on Ealing: a blue band behind the headings, grey behind the vaccine names and a box round every cell) no longer reach it.
